data.name: Ajlah
data.gender_notes: Ajlah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'A-J-L', meaning 'to release', 'to liberate'. In Islamic tradition, the name Ajlah symbolizes the liberation of the soul from worldly attachments. The name Ajlah carries the meaning “Liberated, Free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ajlah usually hope their child will grow to embody liberated, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ajlah is a name that carries the energy of the sun and the earth. It is a reminder of the beauty and power of nature, and the grace and strength that can be found within oneself.
data.etymology: Ajlah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Liberated, Free.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajlah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
